the_one_exception.note: THIS IS ONE OF THE THREE SEALED VIDEOS and it is NOT silent. Full-track mean_volume -52.9 dB, max_volume -12.2 dB, integrated loudness -22.5 LUFS.
the_one_exception.rest_of_file: silent from 0.02 to 571.13 and from 572.30 to 613.64
the_one_exception.reading: Two steady narrowband tones a musical fifth apart - a designed notification chime. MEASURED on my own instrument (ffmpeg extraction to 16 kHz mono WAV, numpy FFT over the active span, all local): dominant bins 197 Hz and 292 Hz, ratio 1.486 where a perfect fifth is 1.500; 99.9% of spectral energy in 100-400 Hz; 0.0% in 1-4 kHz and 0.0% in 4-8 kHz; centroid 249 Hz; active span 0.88s, peak -12.2 dBFS. Intelligible speech REQUIRES substantial 1-4 kHz energy (F2/F3 formants) and consonant energy above 4 kHz. There is none. The content was NOT transcribed and was NOT sent to any external service. Held as HYPOTHESIS for what the chime IS; the exclusion of speech is MEASURED.
the_one_exception.consequence: No video carries spoken explanation. That now rests on a spectral measurement of the only audible span in the corpus, not on its duration and not on an assumption of silence - three different claims that earlier versions of this block conflated in turn.
the_one_exception.retracted_reasoning: An earlier version of this block justified the no-speech conclusion by DURATION - '1.17 seconds cannot carry a spoken explanation'. The independent grader refuted that and it is accepted: conversational English runs 4-6 syllables per second, so 1.17s carries 4-7 syllables, which is easily 'that's the retest' or 'there's the entry' - a complete teaching statement about a TP. Duration does NOT rule out speech. The right answer was reached by the wrong reason, and the reason has been replaced by the spectral measurement above. This is the same defect as the retraction it was correcting.

audio_disposition.positive_control: A synthesised tone at speech level measures -36.1 dB on the same detector versus -65 to -71 dB for the silent files, so the instrument discriminates content from floor.

fingerprint_anchor.what_this_pins: The sha256 of THIS registry file's own bytes, pinned in the test file as a third location.
fingerprint_anchor.why_not_the_full_semantics_hash: Anchoring the whole build fingerprint would red on every unrelated engine edit among its 73 files, and a guard that reds routinely gets its constant updated reflexively - which trains people to ignore it. Scoping the anchor to this file catches the tamper case the grader actually found (a consistent registry + test-constant edit) without coupling to 72 unrelated files.
fingerprint_anchor.honest_limit: A determined editor can still update all three locations. This does not make tampering impossible; it removes the SILENT property, which is what was claimed and was not true.
fingerprint_anchor.semantics_hash_is_recorded_not_guarded: The build fingerprint value at each landed commit is recorded in the custody receipt as a human-checkable anchor. It is a RECORD, not a test.

THE_ACTUAL_TRAP_ffmpeg_v_error_suppresse.what_happens: `-v error` silences filters that report through the LOG at info level. The command succeeds, prints nothing, and a grep -c returns 0. A blank output is indistinguishable from a genuine zero.
THE_ACTUAL_TRAP_ffmpeg_v_error_suppresse.measured_proof: Identical scene-detect command on item 6, which is KNOWN to change (it switches 15m -> 5m on tape): with `-v error` -> 0 hits. With default verbosity -> 264 hits. Same file, same filter, same threshold. The only difference is the verbosity flag.
THE_ACTUAL_TRAP_ffmpeg_v_error_suppresse.how_often_it_bit: Three times in one session, across two different people and three different filters. It was diagnosed twice and then made again on a third filter without re-checking. This trap is worth more recorded than any tool it appeared to discredit.
THE_ACTUAL_TRAP_ffmpeg_v_error_suppresse.independently_verified: I verified this trap for showinfo and volumedetect and asserted the other four BY CATEGORY - itself a claim beyond its evidence, which I flagged for attack. The fresh grader tested all six and I did NOT over-generalise. With `-v error` vs default: showinfo 0/3816, volumedetect 0/11, silencedetect 0/2, ebur128 0/317, signalstats+metadata 0/1907, and blackdetect 0/1 - the last on a SYNTHESIZED 2-second-black positive control, because blackdetect returned 0 at both verbosities on a real clip and would otherwise have been a false confirmation.

ffmpeg_scene_change_detection.verdict: WORKS. Not retired. select='gt(scene,0.003)' with showinfo at DEFAULT verbosity discriminates cleanly: item 6 (known to change) 264 hits, item 7 (the 1.5s fragment) 0 hits.
ffmpeg_scene_change_detection.real_limitation_measured: It detects scene CUTS, not ACTIVITY. The 08-21 live chart returns 0 across its whole 6m26s even though price is ticking, because tick updates are not cuts. A 0 from this tool means 'no layout change', NOT 'nothing happened'. Reading it as the latter is the mistake to avoid.
ffmpeg_scene_change_detection.independently_reproduced: The fresh grader reproduced my published numbers exactly at my exact command: item 6 = 264, item 7 = 0, item 8 live = 0. It also caught two of its own instrument errors in flight - it first swept at threshold 0.02 instead of my stated 0.003, and then nearly published a disagreement (530 vs 264) caused by `grep -c "Parsed_showinfo"` counting showinfo's two config header lines as frames. That second one is the same trap class as this block documents: a count that looks like a measurement.

The metric is dominated by per-file encoder noise, so absolute values are NOT comparable between recordings. Use it within one file, never to rank two.

This is the desk's own rule broken inside the custody document: a mechanism claim needs its evidence in the same sentence or an explicit HYPOTHESIS label, and 'removes the failure class' had neither.

market_map.final_rule: Structural support/resistance only as the regular level family. Active 15m FVG may itself be the support/resistance interaction band when it appears first. PDH/PDL/PWH/PWL are forbidden.

rejection_entries.final_rule: Authorized S/R or FVG interaction plus completed 5m rejection/control story plus sustained forming-5m force.

normal_breakout.final_rule: First completed 5m beyond S/R or FVG is setup only. The following forming 5m must take the first breakout candle directional extreme and prove sustained force. Normal 5m continuation does not wait for a 15m close.

force_timing.final_rule: 5m is the trader entry chart; completed 1m observations are causal internal reconstruction only. Entry may occur before 5m close after sustained real force.

target_hierarchy.final_rule: The nearest meaningful physical structural S/R reaction, 5m liquidity/reaction cluster, or active 15m FVG owns TP1. If FVG owns the destination, TP is its midpoint.

tp_safe_gap.final_rule: At the frozen 15-MNQ reference display, planned TP1 reward >= $400 is safe enough if every other A+ gate passes; under $400 blocks immediate entry. Untouched close TP1 cannot be blindly skipped.

wait_semantics.final_rule: WAIT is distinct from NO_TRADE and remains WAIT when the frozen replay ends while the trader is still waiting.
